Linked Future
Ichihime
We won! You took down the fake, nyaa!
Wanjirou
Whoa! Everyone safe and sound? The monsters all vanished from the streets, woof!
Natsuki Shinomiya
Heh, when I heard that earth-shaking explosion, I knew you'd won. That final radiance... was as dazzling as the dawn of White Night!
Yui Yagi
Senpai... great job, everyone.
Leafa
Sinon
Yeah, and thank you all for having our backs.
Kaguyahime
Hmph. Since you got Mahjong Soul Shrine back, I'll let it slide that you forgot to offer tribute to me.
Nyaa, give it a rest, bad rabbit! We all saw how close you were to getting your butt kicked, nyaa!
I wouldn't be so smug if I were you, shorty! Mark my words – sooner or later, Mahjong Soul Shrine will be mine!
Ahaha... I'm just glad everything's back to normal.
Asuna
Hehe... It seems to have gotten nice and lively around here again.
Kirito
Whew... Well, at least it's finally over.
Yui
Mama, Papa, I can confirm that the virtual game data is now dispersing from the real world... Crisis averted!
I've also confirmed that the portal back to our world is now complete, so we can go home any time!
Nyaa? You're leaving already?
But we haven't even thanked you properly yet.
But we haven't even played mahjong in the real world yet.
That's right. We're friends now, after all!
Hopefully next time we meet we can relax and unwind with a game of mahjong – without having to save the world again... Ahaha...
Huhhh?! When did you guys play mahjong?! No fair, I wanna play too!
Yeah, I want to win with a Thirteen Orphans.
Nyaa?! That one's super hard to win with, nyaa! Are you the super ambitious type, Sinon?!
I'll make some snacks when the time comes.
Alright, thanks everyone!//nYui, activate the portal. Until next time!
They're gone, nyaa...
Yeah...
I have a feeling we'll be seeing them again though, nyaa!
Mm-hm. With how connected these virtual worlds are... it's certainly possible we'll cross paths again.
Yeah... After all that saving-the-world business, my stomach is howling, woof! Who's up for some ramen?
Heh, to celebrate the world's rebirth, the heroes gather for a victory banquet... Ahh, a truly magnificent finale!
This guy's still in character even now?!
Ichihime? What is it?
My snacks are still back at the VR center, nyaa! I have to go get them! I hope the monsters didn't squish them flat, nyaa!
How can you think about snacks at a time like this?!
Nothing's more important to me than the snacks you give me, Master! Come on, let's hurry, nyaa!
Wait, slow down a second!
Kirito! Asuna! And {var:player_nickname}! You three were amazing together!
Don't look so sad, {var:player_nickname}. We'll meet again, I'm sure of it.
